content: सामर्थ्यम् .²1 Power, force, capacity, ability, strength; निन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् <ls>Bg. 2. 36</ls>. .²2 Sameness of aim or object. .²3 Oneness of meaning or signification. .²4 Adequacy, fitness. .²5 The force or sense of words, the signifying power of a word. .²6 Interest, advantage. .²7 Wealth. (सामर्थ्यात्, सामर्थ्ययोगात् ‘by the force of, on the strength of, by dint of, by reason of, as a consequence of’.)
